name: resistance band jump squat
description: A jump squat with a band adding resistance for a more powerful leg drive.
instructions: Stand on a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Jump up explosively against the band.
Land softly through your toes and heels.
Sink immediately into the next squat.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
